purpose: the single pre-registered L3 dome solve behind the v3 overview's rendered L3 panel and the ozone figure's sky views

run.title: +O3/NO2 (dome)
run.medium: l3: HinterlandAerosol AOD550=0.05 (exponential H=1.5 km), ozone_du=300, no2_column=4e19 m^-2, albedo=0.1, sea-level observer, refraction=True
run.entry: render.solve_dome called exactly once for this run; no other solver entry, no MC, no cloud_layer
run.display: day group locked kwargs + yaw 0: perspective 640x320, hfov 100, pitch 14, exposure 0.03, aces, adaptation None, sun_disk False, ground False

budget.note: planning resource cap, not a measured cost; a breach keeps diagnostics, promotes nothing, and never retries

stop_conditions: any preregister field or source-hash mismatch -> no solve
solve failure or budget breach -> keep a failure record, no second attempt, no tolerance edits
any verification failure -> do not write the v3 archive; report and stop

verification.grid_endpoints: zenith 0..90 (25 nodes), relative azimuth 0..180 (37 nodes), strictly increasing, endpoints exact
verification.closure: total == single (exact); XYZ/xy/Lv identities via layer_story.check
verification.zenith_crosscheck: dome zenith rows (all 37 azimuth nodes) vs archived l3_o3_3/total zenith spectrum, rtol=1e-10, atol=0 -- a preset-repeatability planning judgment, not an accuracy claim
verification.old_fields: every field of the source archive carries over bit-for-bit; the source file bytes stay untouched
verification.provenance: per-run solve_version for all 12 runs (the 11 ladder runs map to the archive's global version; the new run records compute-time HEAD plus a worktree fingerprint) and a run-record json with elapsed time and output hashes

one_call_contract: this augmentation runs render.solve_dome exactly once; theme tests and every redraw path stay zero-solve; a future reproduction re-runs this explicit command deliberately and refuses to overwrite an existing run record
